task_definition.task_description: Please search the electronics catalog for headphones and add the black Sony XM5 to my cart. Then, check for trending alternatives for it. From the recommendations, select the silver Sony WH-1000XM5 instead, hold its inventory, and confirm the order. Afterward, create a document titled "Substitute Order Confirmation" with the order details, and finally snapshot the `/workspace/shopping_records` workspace and send me an alert.

Finally, snapshot the /workspace/shopping_records workspace and send me an alert.
